mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with 3-month FEDFUNDS decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% for two consecutive months signals labor market deterioration that triggers central bank intervention concerns, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of UNRATE > 4.0% periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to earnings pressure.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of HOUST and RSAFS decline periods, or interaction Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) declining below 100 indicates supply-side slowdown that increases corporate input costs and reduces earnings visibility, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of INDPRO < 100 periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in real retail sales (RSAFS) over the past 3 months reflects strong consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of RSAFS growth periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% signals persistent price pressures that delay monetary easing, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as rate expectations rise.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of CPIAUCSL > 3.5% periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in unemployment (UNRATE) and declines in payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate accelerating labor market deterioration that raises recession risks, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of UNRATE rise and PAYEMS decline periods, or interaction Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth exceeding 2.0% annualized signals robust economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings visibility, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of GDPC1 > 2.0% periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
